description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest quality of patient care, and maintaining regulatory compliance within the facility.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, training, and development, fostering a positive and efficient work environment. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence in long-term care.
requirements: Registered Nurse (RN) license, preferred
Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Registered Nurse to lead our nursing team as Director of Nursing (DON) at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. If you are a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background and a passion for excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As DON, you will be instrumental in shaping the quality of care provided, managing nursing staff, and fostering a supportive and professional environment. This role comes with a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $110,000, reflecting the importance of this position and your valuable expertise. Join a team committed to making a positive impact on the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Strong understanding of skilled nursing facility operations and regulatory requirements
Proven ability to manage and mentor nursing staff effectively
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $110,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This full-time leadership opportunity is ideal for a Registered Nurse (RN) who is passionate about delivering high-quality patient care and supporting a dynamic nursing team. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of nursing services and maintaining exceptional standards of care.

As an ADON, you will assist the Director of Nursing in planning, organizing, and directing the overall nursing operations of the facility. Your responsibilities will include supervising nursing staff, overseeing resident care, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. This position offers an attractive annual salary range of $70,000 - $80,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment.

If you are a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background and a desire to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time position, and we are not considering interim candidates at this time.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license (preferred)
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $70,000 - $80,000 based on experience.

description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Gulfport, MS, as a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN). We are seeking dedicated LPNs to provide exceptional patient care during our full-time PM shift, from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM. This is a fantastic opportunity to become a vital part of a compassionate healthcare team committed to resident well-being.

In this role, you will utilize your clinical skills to monitor patient health, administer medications, and collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive care plans are followed. We value LPNs who are proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about making a difference in the lives of our residents.

We are specifically looking for candidates who are comfortable and committed to the PM shift schedule. This is a full-time position, not PRN, offering stability and a consistent schedule.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in Mississippi.
Minimum of one year of experience as an LPN, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Ability to work the full-time PM shift (3:00 PM - 11:00 PM).
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills.
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $25.00 - $28.00 based on experience.
